_comment: Split out from Downtown Dayton per Changelog v1.3. Minutes from the Oregon District but a completely different look, which is the point — two stops, two moods, one evening.
name: The Dayton Art Institute
accessNote: Access confirmed — Julie's husband retired from the Art Institute. Relationship-based rather than formal; re-check annually (see RELEASE_REVIEW.md).
shortDescription: Stone balustrades, wide terraces and the whole city spread out behind you — the river, the bridges, the skyline. Architectural and a little grand, without feeling stiff.
bestFor: Grads and couples who want something with structure and scale behind them. Pairs naturally with the Oregon District, a few minutes away.
restrooms: None — sessions here are on the building's exterior only (the front curved steps and balustrade).
parking: Available in the museum's parking lot.
